title: Mac CLI: transcribe, install_mac, cross-platform transcribe hook, generate-from-image --prompt
paragraphs:
- Add POSIX transcribe (ffmpeg + faster-whisper) and deps.sh; install_mac links tools.
- Share runTranscribeForVideo: Windows uses C:\dev\tools\transcribe.bat when present, else transcribe on PATH.
- generate-from-image: --prompt/--variations/--aspect/--size non-interactive mode; open/folder use macOS open.
- video-to-markdown and video-description clipboard fixes; ghopen test harness stubs gh and clears GHOPEN_OPEN_COMMAND.
- img-upscale fast binary name on non-Windows; gitignore task-stats *_with_audio mux outputs.
- Document model tiers in transcribe README; AGENTS file tree includes tools/lib.

title: converted to bun scripts and whatnot
Replace video-titles Neutralinojs UI with simple CLI chat tool
paragraphs: Scraps the Neutralinojs/TypeScript/Vite frontend in favour of a plain PowerShell script. Right-clicking a video now opens a terminal session that auto-detects (or offers to generate) the SRT, then drops into an interactive chat with Gemini via OpenRouter. Each exchange is logged to a JSONL file next to the video.

- video-titles.ps1: full CLI chat loop, SRT detection, transcribe runner
- video-titles.bat: thin wrapper for PATH / stub usage
- install.ps1: adds Write-BatStub for video-titles, switches context menu from wscript/vbs to cmd.exe /k
- deps.ps1: simplified to no-op
- README.md: new tool-level readme
- Deleted all Neutralinojs files
- Model updated to google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

title: Replace C# WinForms with Neutralinojs + web UI
paragraphs: Rewrites the tool using Neutralinojs (WebView2-based, ~2MB binary, no Chromium bundled). The frontend is plain HTML/CSS/JS with marked.js for markdown rendering of AI responses.

Key changes:
- Dark sidebar with Chat / Transcript / Video navigation
- Markdown rendered properly in chat (bold, lists, numbered items)
- Hot-reload dev workflow via 'neu run' or build-and-run.bat
- neu build produces a portable dist in < 1 second
- deps.ps1 auto-downloads the Neutralinojs binary + client via 'neu update'
- Removed C# .csproj, MSBuild dependency, and all .cs source files
- VBS/PS1 launchers and install.ps1 context menu entry unchanged

title: Redesign UI with left sidebar navigation
paragraphs: Replace stacked panels with a sidebar (Video / Transcript / Chat) + content area. Remove notes/creator context field. Pre-fill chat input with 'Please give me 10 options'. Drop notes param from OpenRouterClient.ChatAsync.

title: add video-titles tool with .env pattern for API keys
paragraphs: New tool: right-click a video in Explorer -> Mike's Tools -> Video Titles. Opens a C# WinForms chat UI backed by OpenRouter (google/gemini-2.5-flash) that lets you ideate YouTube titles using the Compelling Title Matrix framework. Auto-loads the matching .srt transcript if the transcribe tool has already run.

Repo-wide .env pattern:
- .env.example documents OPENROUTER_API_KEY (committed)
- .env is git-ignored; loaded by install.ps1 and video-titles.ps1 at startup
- install.ps1 hard-errors with a clear message if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing
